entity_name: North Haven Private Income Fund LLC
author: agentA induced (sandboxed) from bundle 0001851322.json; Morgan Stanley North Haven first-lien-debt dialect, flattened-concatenation regime.

applies_to.note: Dominant rate-bearing variant under the per-CIK anchors (2880 rows, 35.8% of the CIK): floating first/second-lien debt phrased '<affil header> Debt Investments <industry> <issuer> Investment First Lien Debt Reference Rate and Spread S + <spread>% (incl. <pik>% PIK) Interest Rate <allin>% Maturity Date m/d/yyyy'. SPREAD IS PERCENT (7.00% -> twin 0.07), NOT bps -- confirmed against every sample twin (S + 7.00% -> basis_spread 0.07; S + 5.00% -> 0.05; S + 6.60% -> 0.066). The stated 'Interest Rate' is the ALL-IN coupon; the reference index VALUE (SOFR) is not printed in the string, so interest_rate_all_in is taken verbatim and gated against the interest_rate twin. The PIK clause uses the explicit '(incl. X% PIK)' wording -> PIK is INCLUDED in the all-in (inclusive convention); cash leg = all_in - pik. Equity rows ('AFFIL EQUITY MAT' / 'MAT') carry only an Acquisition Date and no rate; they are a separate, non-rate-bearing variant and are NOT covered here.

_pik_convention_doc: North Haven prints 'Reference Rate and Spread S + <spread>% (incl. <pik>% PIK) Interest Rate <allin>%'. The literal token 'incl.' (included) is decisive: the PIK leg is part of the all-in Interest Rate, not added on top. Twin cross-check confirms this: BPG Holdings 'S + 7.00% (incl. 5.00% PIK) Interest Rate 11%' -- with SOFR ~4% the floating coupon is ~4 + 7 = ~11% all-in, and the 5.00% PIK is a portion of that 11% paid in kind rather than 11% + 5% = 16% additive. Likewise Firebird 'S + 5.00% (incl. 2.75% PIK) Interest Rate 9.31%' (~4.3 SOFR + 5.00 spread ~= 9.31 all-in; 2.75% of that is PIK). So convention = inclusive (like Bain/Antares), NOT additive (unlike MidCap's 'cash plus X PIK'). cash leg = all_in - pik. No self-contained 'X% cash plus Y% PIK = Z%' total is printed and the reference index value is absent, so NO sum_identity is possible; gating is against the reliable structured twins via pct_agree/date_agree.
_reference_code_doc: Reference appears as the single letter 'S' in 'Reference Rate and Spread S + <spread>%'. 'S' = SOFR: this is Morgan Stanley / North Haven shorthand, the index is U.S.-dollar term SOFR for first/second-lien USD direct loans (2021+ vintage, post-LIBOR-transition). The code map also retains the full words SOFR/LIBOR/EURIBOR/PRIME and the letters E (EURIBOR) and P/SF for robustness across quarters, but every sample in this bundle uses bare 'S'.
